what: Moving inference, MIR and borrow check onto the kernel's served entries broke every old item-store test that flushed records in one database and hit them in another; those tests have no syntax world, so they now get the kernel's verdict from a helper (kept_by_the_kernel / served_by_the_kernel) while the real kernel path is tested in entries/tests.rs. The production world for the body entries needs the daemon's file texts and its front-end kernel, which live in serve/front_carry.rs (another lane's file), so the driver could not be built inside deps.rs alone.
cause: the old tests were written against the record store, not against an interface the kernel also implements; the front-end kernel's world (front_carry::Tree) is not a BodyWorld
class: a test harness tied to a deleted path; a driver split across lanes' files
prevention: front_carry::Tree should implement BodyWorld (it already holds the files and the kernel), so body entries register on the one front-end kernel
workaround: test helper posting the kernel's verdict
